def migrate_data(self, data, from_state):
        """Migrate data objects.

        :param data: Queryset containing all data objects that need
            to be migrated
        :param from_state: Database model state
        """
        for item in data:
            # Update the state of the data object.
            item.state = to_state
            # Update the state of the data object's parent object,
            # if it has one.
            if item.parent is not None:
                item.parent.state = to_state
                item.parent.save()
            # Save the data object.
            item.save()
